focus_areas: Structural integrity of the receiver and stock connection
Presence of functional components (sights, magazine, trigger)
Boundary separation between weapon and soldier
custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the 'fusion' artifact where the gun meets the soldier. This is a common AI failure mode. Also, note the complete absence of sights/rails on top of the receiver, which makes the object functionally invalid as an assault rifle regardless of the silhouette. The fine_grained_classifier may still label this 'assault rifle' due to global shape bias, so prioritize the topological and geometric evidence over the classification label.

expert_testimonies.reason: To check if the barrel and receiver have valid depth separation from the background and the soldier, ensuring the weapon isn't partially flattened into the background.
To verify if the model recognizes the object as an assault rifle despite the severe geometric distortions, or if it classifies it as a generic 'gun' or 'toy'.
To precisely segment the weapon from the soldier and confirm the fusion artifact at the stock/shoulder interface and the lack of clear boundaries between components.
To analyze the surface textures and lighting consistency, specifically checking for the 'waxy' look and lack of metallic specular highlights.
